name: Commnet Internet Services
summary: Sydney south (Taren Point) dialup ISP (unlimited plans); ISP homepage in Wayback only 2001-02, defunct by mid-2000s (CRANFIELD, KRIS (sole trader), ABN 24 508 910 551).

events.details: Listed in the Cynosure ISP directory (2001); earliest own-domain Wayback capture Dec 2001.

ISP homepage present in Wayback only 2001-02; no captures 2003-2013, then a minimal placeholder page 2014-2019 (not an active ISP). Exact closure unclear; retail ISP presence gone by mid-2000s. Full ISP site Jan 2002; acquisition-by-The-Planet-Internet announced on the homepage by 3 Jun 2002 and the site then vanished from the archive for 12 years; trading name dropped Feb 2003 — death is 2002, not 2003 or 2005.

refs.label: Last full retail ISP homepage, 20 Jan 2002
3 Jun 2002: acquisition notice + webmail; then zero captures for 12 years (verified via CDX 2002-2013)
